headline: Saini government makes big announcement for businesses in Haryana, Rs 311.25 crore released to 670 beneficiaries
summary: Haryana released a first tranche of incentives totalling Rs 311.25 crore to 670 beneficiaries under MSME Directorate and Directorate of Industries and Commerce schemes, via the e-Kuber treasury system.
why: State incentive schemes for small and medium enterprises affect business investment and employment in Indian states.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: हरियाणा में कारोबारियों के लिए सैनी सरकार ने बड़ा ऐलान, 670 लाभार्थियों को 311.25 करोड़ रुपये जारी
